_help: Change "site" to your own domain, then run: node build-pages.js. That single edit rewrites every canonical URL, the sitemap, the Open Graph tags and the JSON-LD across all 180 tool pages. No trailing slash.
_analytics: Page-view counting is configured in assets/js/zt-analytics.js — set provider and endpoint at the top of that file. It is deliberately not duplicated here: it runs in the browser, not at build time, and two places to change one setting is one place too many.
_migration_checklist: 1. Buy the domain and point its DNS at GitHub Pages.
2. Add the domain in Settings > Pages > Custom domain (this writes the CNAME file).
5. Commit and push. Then add the new domain as a property in Google Search Console and submit sitemap.xml.
